name: @tabnas/ini
description: INI configuration-file parsing for the tabnas engine.

loss: Every key and every string value is written double-quoted; a section name, a boolean and null are written as they are.
A number is written by its lexeme, or as Infinity, -Infinity or NaN, and reads back as a string, since the reader builds every unquoted value but true, false and null as a string.
A key that ends in a pair of square brackets reads back as an array under the name before them, since that is the reader's array mark inside quotes too.
A section name is written with its dots, closing brackets and backslashes escaped, so one that starts with a quote, holds a line break or is padded with whitespace does not read back as written.
A member that follows a section inside a section is written after that section's header again, which reads back as written only while section.duplicate is merge, the default.
A root member that follows a section, an array holding an array or an object, an empty array, and an empty key naming a section or an array have no INI form and are refused.
